title: SQL Query Basics: SELECT to NULL

scenes.line1: Can you filter and sort rows?
scenes.say: SQL querying is all about finding the right data. Can you filter, sort, and handle missing values?

scenes.label: SELECT
scenes.say: SELECT pulls columns from your table. It's the foundation of every SQL query.
Use WHERE to filter, ORDER BY to sort, and LIMIT to restrict how many rows you get back.
Never use equals for NULL. Always check with IS NULL or IS NOT NULL. Comparisons won't work as expected.

scenes.question: How do you check for NULL?
scenes.right: Use salary IS NULL or salary IS NOT NULL
scenes.say: Interviewers love asking about NULLs. If you use equals, your query won't work. Always use IS NULL.
